data.description: Go-sweep audit finding. store/batcher.go ~87-94: LastError is the designed surface for timer-driven background flush failures, and no production code reads it (only store_test.go). Failed events stay pending and the next synchronous Flush surfaces the error, so nothing is lost — but a repo where writes stop after a timer-flush failure holds an error nobody will see or log. Wire it into daemon status/logging, or delete it. Behavior decision, out of the sweep's scope.
data.title: Batcher.LastError is a reporting channel nobody reads
